subject: SAML issuer mismatch causing tenant routing to wrong supplier portal
messages:
From: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@livemart.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble accepting supplier portal access — routed to another org

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

We're trying to complete the supplier portal setup for LiveMart (account: LIV-2047) but when our procurement lead clicks the portal invite we get redirected to a different tenant (shows as "Tenant: Westgrove Supplies" in the top-left). The error page says: "Tenant mapping failed: issuer mismatch".

Attached a screenshot of the error and a snippet of the browser SAML console. Our IdP is Okta and the admin says the SAML Assertion seems fine on our side, but the portal is matching on the wrong tenant. We haven't been able to upload our tax docs because the account landing page is wrong.

Can someone triage? We need this resolved before the PO goes out tomorrow.

Attachments: sso-error-screenshot.png (png), saml-response.log (text)

Thanks,
Ellie Ramos
Vendor Enablement
LiveMart Inc.
ellie.ramos@livemart.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@livemart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier portal access — routed to another org

Hi Ellie — thanks for the details and the screenshots. Sorry for the trouble. We see two likely causes:

1) The SAML issuer (EntityID) coming from Okta might include a trailing path or different subdomain that doesn't match the tenant mapping key in our portal.
2) A stale metadata file on our side (the tenant mapping table) could be pointing the issuer to the wrong LiveMart tenant.

Can you send the IdP metadata XML (or the issuer string) and a full SAMLResponse if possible (we only need the base64-decoded text). I can also provision a temporary direct link that bypasses tenant auto-route so your team can upload the tax docs while we fix mapping.

Temporary bypass link (expires 24h): https://supplier.redwood.ai/d/accept/temporary/LIV-2047

I'll loop in internal ops to check the tenant mapping table and the metadata we have for LiveMart.

—Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415-555-0182
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Trouble accepting supplier portal access — routed to another org

Folks — forwarding LiveMart issue. Karthik confirmed temporary bypass link provided. Can ops/dev team confirm which tenant key our routing table is matching for issuer: 

  Issuer claimed by LiveMart (from their metadata preview): https://auth.livemart.okta.com/app/abcd1234/sso/saml

Symptoms: redirect to Westgrove Supplies (tenant id: WGS-900), error message: "Tenant mapping failed: issuer mismatch".

Please check: 
- tenant_mapping table for any rows with partial issuer matches or regex rules
- recent metadata imports (last 30 days) that could have modified mapping for that issuer domain
- whether any automated cleanup job collapsed similar issuers to a single tenant id (we saw a cleanup rule last month)

Let me know if you need their metadata XML (they offered to attach it). This is time-sensitive (PO tomorrow).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@livemart.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier portal access — routed to another org

Karthik / Marissa — quick update: our IdP admin exported the metadata and found the EntityID included the app path ("/app/abcd1234/sso/saml") rather than the org-level issuer. Monica confirmed she updated the tenant mapping to match the full EntityID string instead of the domain-level rule, and that fixed it. We were able to accept the invite and upload the PO documentation.

I've attached the decoded SAMLResponse for your logs (saml-response.log). Please keep the temporary bypass link active for another 2 hours in case our procurement lead needs it.

Appreciate the quick help — lean timeline on our end but all set now.

Best,
Ellie Ramos
Vendor Enablement
LiveMart Inc.
ellie.ramos@livemart.com
